You typed it into your phone. That may be why you forgot it.

Kevin Trudeau says research shows typing on a keyboard activates only about nine neural pathways. Printing activates around 37, and cursive activates hundreds.

So when you write a to-do by hand, your brain is far more engaged. You don't forget it, and your subconscious keeps working on it.

What do you still write by hand, and what do you only type?

Kevin's free training, Your Wish Is Your Command, is in my highlights.
